title: dia_extraction input
description: Input parameters for the DIA spectrum evidence extraction pipeline.

search_results.description: Path to DIA search results (Spectronaut report, S14-style table, or pFind-Filtered.spectra). Must contain peptide sequences, charges, m/z, sample/run identifiers, and per-sample RT values.

raw_mapping.description: TSV mapping run_name to raw_path. Auto-generated if null.

protein_fasta.description: Protein FASTA for flanking residue annotation. Header format '>Mtb|Rv0054|ssb' for Mtb proteins.

table1_xlsx.description: Manuscript Table 1 xlsx for cross-reference PDF generation.

prediction_pkl.description: AlphaPeptDeep prediction pkl. Auto-generated via 86_predict_missing.py for missing entries.

rt_tolerance_min.description: RT anchor tolerance for apex search (minutes). Widen to 1.2 if fewer than 2 candidate scans found.

background_ion_floor.description: Ion-level background removal: intensity must be >= this fraction of the ion's apex intensity.

row_quant_threshold.description: Row-level quant threshold: elution window peak must be >= this multiple of the out-of-window baseline.

absolute_bg_line.description: Absolute background line: bin raw value must be >= this multiple of row baseline to count as quantified.

heatmap_cutoff_pct.description: Per-row display cutoff: bins below this fraction of row max are blanked.

output_dir.description: Output directory for evidence PDFs, extraction results, and audit reports.
